---
description: "Perform exactly one approved troubleshooting iteration with artifact notes."
name: "Perform One Troubleshooting Iteration"
argument-hint: "Artifact folder path and approved iteration goal from previous iteration note"
---
Execute one approved troubleshooting iteration.

1. Create the next iteration file in the existing artifact folder (e.g. iteration-002-change-and-test.md).
2. Implement only the change approved in the previous iteration note.
3. Run relevant tests and record results.
4. Document in the iteration file: what was inspected, what was changed, why, tests run, result, and next recommended step.
5. Stop after this single iteration and request approval before continuing.

For a detailed step-by-step playbook use the `investigate-bug-troubleshooting-workflow` skill.
